name: Fool's Gold: Dice, Death & Dating
source:
Fool's Gold: Dice, Death & Dating is a TTRPG-inspired dating adventure game in which you, a daring adventurer, dive into the world's deadliest jungle to get a hot date for the annual Bundariko Ball.

Your adventure will take you through a deadly jungle before you find your way to the town of Bundariko, a ramshackle little dive full of adventurers, cultists, and single bachelors.

Who will you try to woo? The druid? The magical girl? The monster? Or others?

Well, perhaps first try to make sure your choices don't get you killed and THEN worry about the smoochin'.

And of course, don't trust the monkey.

[From [url=https://cryodon.games/foolsgold/] official site]
translation:
《Fool's Gold: Dice, Death & Dating》是一款受TTRPG启发的约会冒险游戏，在游戏中，你作为一个勇敢的冒险家，潜入世界上最致命的丛林，在一年一度的Bundariko Ball中找到一位炙手可热的约会对象。

你的冒险将带你穿过一片致命的丛林，然后找到前往Bundariko镇的路，这是一个摇摇欲坠的小潜水点，充满了冒险家、邪教徒和单身汉。

你会尝试去追求谁？德鲁伊？魔法少女？怪物？还是其他人？

好吧，也许首先要确保你的选择不会让你丧命，然后再担心接吻的问题。

当然，不要相信猴子。

[来自[url=https://cryodon.games/foolsgold/]官方网站]
